    if not s:
        return None

        return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        # fallback: remove timezone info if present
        try:
            s2 = re.sub(r'(\+00:00|Z)$','',s)
            return datetime.fromisoformat(s2)
        except Exception:
            return None

import re

# Login tokens (fetch again to avoid stale values)

amazon_token = apis.amazon.login(username='clmiller@gmail.com', password=creds['amazon'])['access_token']

note_id = 3084
now = datetime.now()
month_str = f"{now.month:02d}/{str(now.year)[2:]}"

# recompute total paid for this month (so value is definitely current)

def parse_dt(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        try:
            s2 = re.sub(r'(\\+00:00|Z)$','',s)
            return datetime.fromisoformat(s2)
        except Exception:
            return None

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_orders=[]
while True:
    resp = apis.amazon.show_orders(access_token=amazon_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    orders = resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('orders', [])
    if not orders:
        break
    all_orders.extend(orders)
    page_index += 1

sum_paid = 0.0
for o in all_orders:
    dt = parse_dt(o.get('created_at'))
    if dt and dt.month == now.month and dt.year == now.year:
        sum_paid += float(o.get('paid_amount', 0.0) or 0.0)

paid_amount = round(sum_paid, 2)
added_content = f"- {month_str} => ${paid_amount:.2f}"

# verify not already in note content

content = existing.get('content','')

# verify after

print('present_after', added_content in updated.get('content',''))
print('tail_after:\n', updated.get('content','')[-300:])
